research.name: Shader Park
research.note: JavaScript library that compiles short sculpting scripts into raymarched signed distance field shaders for three.js, p5, Hydra and TouchDesigner.

effects: JavaScript sculpting code compiled to raymarched SDF GLSL shaders
noise-displaced shapes via expand() driven by space and time
mirrored and displaced coordinate space to repeat one primitive into a folding structure
one sculpture exported to three.js, p5, Hydra, TouchDesigner and raw SDF meshing targets
